headlines.title: 中国人民银行副行长宣昌能出席国际清算银行行长例会
headlines.summary: 2026年11月8日至9日，中国人民银行副行长宣昌能出席国际清算银行（BIS）在瑞士巴塞尔举行的行长例会。与会央行行长就全球经济金融形势、外汇市场运行、央行资产负债表、人工智能等议题开展了深入交流。会议期间，宣昌能副行长还会见了部分与会央行代表，就共同关心的问题和双边金融合作交换了意见。

headlines.title_en: PBOC Deputy Governor Xuan Changneng attends BIS Governors' Meeting
headlines.summary_en: From November 8 to 9, 2026, PBOC Deputy Governor Xuan Changneng attended the regular meeting of central bank governors held by the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) in Basel, Switzerland. The attending central bank governors held in-depth exchanges on topics including the global economic and financial situation, foreign exchange market operations, central bank balance sheets and artificial intelligence. During the meeting, Deputy Governor Xuan Changneng also met with some attending central bank representatives to exchange views on issues of common concern and bilateral financial cooperation.

headlines.title: 德国央行行长：德国经济复苏快于预期 仍需推进结构性改革
headlines.summary: 德国央行行长内格尔表示，德国经济复苏速度快于几个月前的预期，但政府必须继续推进结构性改革，以确保长期经济增长。内格尔周三在里加举行的一场会议上表示，最新经济数据和预测已显现令人鼓舞的改善迹象，暗示德国央行可能在下个月上调经济增长预测，但这些积极趋势不应成为政府放松警惕的理由。他指出，增加国防和基础设施公共支出，加上经济周期性复苏，仍无法解决德国面临的结构性问题。尽管受到伊朗战争引发的通胀压力及美国关税政策冲击，欧洲最大经济体德国今年的经济表现仍好于预期，公共支出大幅增加是推动经济扩张的重要因素。德国政府近期已将2026年经济增长预测上调至1.3%。纳格尔

headlines.title_en: Bundesbank President: Germany's economic recovery is faster than expected, but structural reforms still need to be advanced
headlines.summary_en: Bundesbank President Nagel said Germany's economic recovery is faster than expected a few months ago, but the government must continue to advance structural reforms to ensure long-term economic growth. Speaking at a conference in Riga on Wednesday, Nagel said the latest economic data and forecasts have shown encouraging signs of improvement, suggesting the Bundesbank may raise its growth forecast next month, but these positive trends should not be a reason for the government to let down its guard. He noted that increased public spending on defense and infrastructure, combined with the cyclical economic recovery, still cannot solve the structural problems Germany faces. Despite inflationary pressure triggered by the Iran war and the impact of US tariff policy, Germany, Europe's largest economy, has performed better than expected this year, with a sharp increase in public spending an important factor driving economic expansion. headlines.title: 离岸信托收益征税平稳有序推进，10月当月入库超1200亿元
headlines.summary: 从国家税务总局获悉，目前，离岸信托收益征税政策过渡期已平稳结束，绝大多数纳税人积极配合，累计申报离岸信托个人所得税超1600亿元，其中10月当月入库超1200亿元，带动了全国10月份个人所得税收入增长近90%。2026年7月24日，财政部、税务总局发布《关于离岸信托个人所得税有关事项的公告》，规定取得离岸信托收益的纳税人在90天过渡期内完成申报缴税，不加收滞纳金。 (新华社)

headlines.title_en: Taxation of offshore trust income proceeds steadily and orderly, with over 120 billion yuan collected in October alone
headlines.summary_en: The State Taxation Administration said that the transition period for the tax policy on offshore trust income has now ended smoothly, with the vast majority of taxpayers actively cooperating, and a cumulative total of over 160 billion yuan in individual income tax on offshore trust income declared, of which more than 120 billion yuan was collected in October alone, driving a nearly 90% increase in national individual income tax revenue in October. On July 24, 2026, the Ministry of Finance and the State Taxation Administration issued the Announcement on Matters Concerning Individual Income Tax on Offshore Trusts, stipulating that taxpayers receiving offshore trust income must complete declaration and tax payment within a 90-day transition period, without late fees. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Finance plans to issue 2026 book-entry discount treasury bonds (74th tranche) with a total tender face value of 60 billion yuan
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance plans to issue 2026 book-entry discounted treasury bonds (74th issue). This issue is a 182-day discounted bond. The total face value of competitive bidding for this issue is 60 billion yuan, with additional bidding by Class A members. The issue price will be determined through competitive bidding and issued at a discount below par. Interest on this issue begins accruing on November 19, 2026, and it will be repaid at par on May 20, 2027 (postponed for holidays). Bidding time is from 10:35 to 11:35 a.m. on November 18, 2026.

headlines.title: 东北证券廖博：科技为矛、商品为盾，“双创”板块有望实现估值修复
headlines.summary: 东北证券宏观首席分析师廖博在2026上海总量观澜论坛上表示，近期市场波动主要表现为流动性再平衡，流动性或成为大类资产定价主线，股市表现有望向内涵价值收敛，前期调整较多的科创板、创业板有望实现估值修复；全球市场将在流动性波动环境中震荡运行，基本面和企业盈利韧性决定后续表现的斜率与可持续性。产业层面，AI算力、先进存储等需求带动硬科技链量价齐升，以AI、机器人、创新药为代表的新质生产力企业业绩延续高增，完备制造业体系与产品性价比红利正转化为出口出海型企业的全球竞争优势。配置上可概括为“科技为矛、商品为盾”，2027年出口仍是中国经济的结构性亮点。(人民财讯)

headlines.title_en: Northeast Securities' Liao Bo: Technology as the spear, commodities as the shield; the ChiNext and STAR Market sectors are expected to see valuation recovery
headlines.summary_en: Liao Bo, chief macro analyst at Northeast Securities, said at the 2026 Shanghai Macro Outlook Forum that recent market volatility is mainly a liquidity rebalancing, and liquidity may become the main thread of large asset class pricing; stock market performance is expected to converge toward intrinsic value, and the STAR Market and ChiNext, which saw larger corrections earlier, are expected to achieve valuation repair; global markets will fluctuate in a liquidity-volatile environment, and fundamentals and corporate earnings resilience will determine the slope and sustainability of subsequent performance. At the industry level, demand for AI computing power and advanced storage is driving both volume and price increases across the hard-tech chain, and the performance of new quality productive forces companies represented by AI, robotics and innovative drugs continues to grow rapidly; the dividend from a complete manufacturing system and product cost-effectiveness is being transformed into the global competitive advantage of export-oriented enterprises. In terms of allocation, this can be summarized as "technology as the spear, commodities as the shield"; in 2027, exports will remain a structural highlight of China's economy. (People's Caixin)

headlines.title: 印度禁止出口锂离子电池回收材料
headlines.summary: 印度政府周二宣布，立即禁止出口锂离子电池黑粉黑粉是一种电池回收材料，含有锂、钴、镍和锰等金属。印度政府将该产品的出口状态由“自由出口”调整为“禁止出口”。此次政策调整禁止印度电池回收企业出口锂离子电池黑粉，旨在鼓励关键电池材料在印度国内加工，支持印度发展电动汽车供应链的战略目标。根据印度商务和工业部及商务部发布的通知，出口禁令适用于锂离子电池黑粉，以及未经分类且不含铅、镉或汞的相关电池废料。印度是全球增长最快的电动汽车市场之一。印度政府正大力推动本土电池制造和回收产业发展，并设定目标：到2030年，电动汽车占新车销量的30%，占新售两轮和三轮车销量的80

headlines.title_en: India bans exports of lithium-ion battery recycling materials
headlines.summary_en: The Indian government announced on Tuesday an immediate ban on exports of lithium-ion battery black mass, a battery recycling material containing metals such as lithium, cobalt, nickel and manganese. The Indian government changed the product's export status from "free export" to "prohibited export." This policy adjustment bans Indian battery recycling companies from exporting lithium-ion battery black mass, aiming to encourage domestic processing of key battery materials in India and support India's strategic goal of developing an electric vehicle supply chain. According to a notification issued by India's Ministry of Commerce and Industry and the Department of Commerce, the export ban applies to lithium-ion battery black mass and related unsorted battery waste that does not contain lead, cadmium or mercury. India is one of the world's fastest-growing electric vehicle markets. The Indian government is vigorously promoting the domestic battery manufacturing and recycling industry and has set targets for electric vehicles to account for 30% of new car sales and 80% of new two- and three-wheeler sales by 2030.

headlines.title: 王毅同古巴党和政府特使、古共中央政治局委员、外交部长罗德里格斯会谈
headlines.summary: 11月11日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在北京同古巴党和政府特使、古共中央政治局委员、外交部长罗德里格斯举行会谈。王毅说，在两国元首战略引领下，两党两国关系持续发展，传统友谊焕发新的生机活力。中方愿同古方共同落实好两国元首重要共识，不断巩固好、发展好中古友好关系，持续构建更加紧密的中古命运共同体。中方愿同古方加强多边领域沟通协作，继续在多边舞台上相互支持配合，共同反对强权政治和单边行径，推动全球南方的联合自强，构建更加公正合理的全球治理体系。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Wang Yi holds talks with Rodriguez, special envoy of the Communist Party of Cuba and the Cuban government, member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of Cuba Central Committee and Foreign Minister
headlines.summary_en: On November 11, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, held talks in Beijing with Rodriguez, special envoy of the Cuban Party and government, member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of Cuba Central Committee and Foreign Minister. Wang Yi said that under the strategic guidance of the two heads of state, relations between the two parties and two countries have continued to develop, and traditional friendship has gained new vitality. China is willing to work with Cuba to jointly implement the important consensus of the two heads of state, continuously consolidate and develop China-Cuba friendly relations, and continue building a closer China-Cuba community with a shared future. China is willing to strengthen communication and coordination with Cuba in multilateral fields, continue mutual support and cooperation on the multilateral stage, jointly oppose power politics and unilateral acts, promote the collective self-strengthening of the Global South, and build a more just and reasonable global governance system. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 离岸信托收益征税平稳有序推进
headlines.summary: 11月11日从国家税务总局获悉，目前，离岸信托收益征税政策过渡期已平稳结束，绝大多数纳税人积极配合，累计申报离岸信托个人所得税超1600亿元，其中10月当月入库超1200亿元，带动了全国10月份个人所得税收入增长近90%。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Taxation of offshore trust income proceeds steadily and orderly
headlines.summary_en: On November 11, the State Taxation Administration said that the transition period for the tax policy on offshore trust income has now ended smoothly, with the vast majority of taxpayers actively cooperating, and a cumulative total of over 160 billion yuan in individual income tax on offshore trust income declared, of which more than 120 billion yuan was collected in October alone, driving a nearly 90% increase in national individual income tax revenue in October. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title_en: Dashang Group, up 5 times in 7 days: Abnormal stock trading fluctuation, performance sharply declined in the first three quarters
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, November 11 — Large Oriental announced that the cumulative deviation of the closing price increase of the company's A-shares over two consecutive trading days, November 10 and November 11, 2026, reached 20.38%, constituting an abnormal fluctuation in stock trading. From November 3 to November 11, 2026, the company hit the daily limit up 5 times in 7 trading days, with a cumulative increase of 65.32%, significantly higher than the industry index increase over the same period, posing risks of irrational speculation and rapid decline, and its estimated full-year price-earnings ratio is significantly higher than the industry level. After self-examination and inquiries to the controlling shareholder and actual controller, there are no major undisclosed matters that should be disclosed, and during the abnormal period, directors, supervisors, senior management, the controlling shareholder and the actual controller did not buy or sell the company's shares. In the first three quarters of 2026, the company's operating revenue was 1.941 billion yuan, down 26.61% year on year; net profit attributable to shareholders was 8.4092 million yuan, down 84.8%.

headlines.title: 杭可科技：拟以5000万元-1亿元回购公司股份
headlines.summary: 杭可科技公告，拟以集中竞价交易方式回购公司股份，回购资金总额不低于人民币5000万元（含）、不超过人民币1亿元（含），回购价格不超过人民币28元/股（含），回购期限为董事会审议通过回购方案之日起3个月内。回购股份全部用于维护公司价值及股东权益，披露回购结果暨股份变动公告12个月后拟通过集中竞价交易方式出售，并于该公告披露后3年内完成出售；未能按期完成出售的，未出售部分将履行相关程序予以注销。资金来源为自有资金或自筹资金（含回购专项贷款资金），公司已取得工商银行杭州分行不超过人民币9000万元的专项贷款承诺，具体贷款事宜以双方签订的融资协议为准。

headlines.title_en: Hangke Technology: Plans to repurchase company shares for 50 million to 100 million yuan
headlines.summary_en: Hangke Technology announced that it plans to repurchase company shares through centralized bidding, with total repurchase funds of no less than RMB 50 million (inclusive) and no more than RMB 100 million (inclusive), a repurchase price of no more than RMB 28 per share (inclusive), and a repurchase period of within 3 months from the date the board of directors approves the repurchase plan. The repurchased shares will all be used to safeguard the company's value and shareholders' rights and interests, and are planned to be sold through centralized bidding 12 months after disclosure of the repurchase result and share change announcement, with the sale to be completed within 3 years after such announcement; if the sale is not completed on schedule, the unsold portion will be cancelled through relevant procedures. The source of funds is own funds or self-raised funds (including special loan funds for repurchase). The company has obtained a special loan commitment of no more than RMB 90 million from ICBC Hangzhou Branch, with specific loan matters subject to the financing agreement signed by both parties.

headlines.title: 中国注册会计师协会：完善招投标等选聘评价体系 坚决整治行业“内卷式”竞争
headlines.summary: 11月11日，中国注册会计师协会党委书记、秘书长江湧在财政部新闻发布会上表示，“十五五”时期，中国注册会计师协会将紧紧围绕服务国家建设主题和诚信建设主线，着力推进行业规范化。协会将聚焦优化行业发展环境，协调推动企业进一步完善招投标等选聘评价体系，形成以质量为导向的会计事务所选聘机制，坚决整治行业“内卷式”竞争。

headlines.title_en: Chinese Institute of Certified Public Accountants: Improve bidding and other selection and evaluation systems, resolutely tackle "involutionary" competition in the industry
headlines.summary_en: On November 11, Jiang Yong, Party Secretary and Secretary-General of the Chinese Institute of Certified Public Accountants (CICPA), said at a Ministry of Finance press conference that during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period, CICPA will closely focus on the theme of serving national development and the main thread of integrity building, and strive to advance industry standardization. The institute will focus on optimizing the industry development environment, coordinate efforts to help enterprises further improve bidding and other selection and evaluation systems, establish a quality-oriented selection mechanism for accounting firms, and resolutely curb "involution-style" competition in the industry.

headlines.title: 财政部：全链条依法重拳惩治财务报表和审计违法违规行为
headlines.summary: 财政部会计司司长林启云在财政部新闻发布会上表示，“十五五”时期将更加注重法治与监督，财会监督体系是重要抓手。一方面把尺子打准，系统推进会计准则等标准，加快完善注册会计师行业配套制度；另一方面把规矩守严，建设协同高效的会计监督体系，全链条依法重拳惩治财务报表和审计违法违规行为，维护市场经济秩序。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Finance: Crack down hard on financial statement and audit violations throughout the entire chain in accordance with the law
headlines.summary_en: Lin Qiyun, Director of the Accounting Department of the Ministry of Finance, said at a Ministry of Finance press conference that during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period, greater emphasis will be placed on the rule of law and supervision, with the accounting supervision system as an important lever. On the one hand, standards will be applied accurately by systematically advancing accounting standards and other norms and accelerating the improvement of supporting systems for the certified public accountant industry; on the other hand, rules will be strictly enforced by building a coordinated and efficient accounting supervision system, severely punishing violations of laws and regulations in financial statements and auditing across the entire chain in accordance with the law, and safeguarding the order of the market economy.

headlines.title: 截至“十四五”末全国执业注册会计师超10万人
headlines.summary: 财政部会计司司长林启云11月11日表示，截至“十四五”末，全国会计师事务所（含分所）数量超1万家，执业注册会计师超10万人，每年为420万家企事业单位提供专业服务；全国代理记账机构数量超16万家，专职从业人员超58万人，服务中小微企业超1600万家。(新华社)

headlines.title_en: By the end of the 14th Five-Year Plan period, practicing certified public accountants nationwide exceed 100,000
headlines.summary_en: Lin Qiyun, Director of the Accounting Department of the Ministry of Finance, said on November 11 that by the end of the "14th Five-Year Plan" period, the number of accounting firms (including branches) nationwide exceeded 10,000, with more than 100,000 practicing certified public accountants, providing professional services to 4.2 million enterprises and institutions each year; the number of bookkeeping agencies nationwide exceeded 160,000, with more than 580,000 full-time practitioners, serving more than 16 million small, medium, and micro enterprises. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 会计改革与发展“十五五”规划：推动财务造假存量加快出清、增量得到有效遏制
headlines.summary: 财政部印发《会计改革与发展“十五五”规划》。其中提出，会计监督作用更好发挥。会计监督体系更加健全，打击财务造假工作机制进一步完善，对重点领域的监督、突出问题的整治持续发力，精准性、有效性不断提升，推动财务造假存量加快出清、增量得到有效遏制。

headlines.title_en: Accounting Reform and Development 15th Five-Year Plan: Accelerate the clearing of existing financial fraud and effectively curb new fraud
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance issued the "Accounting Reform and Development 15th Five-Year Plan." It proposes that the role of accounting supervision be better leveraged. The accounting supervision system will be more robust, the mechanism for combating financial fraud will be further improved, supervision over key areas and rectification of prominent problems will continue to intensify, precision and effectiveness will keep improving, and efforts will be made to accelerate the clearing of the stock of financial fraud and effectively curb new occurrences.

headlines.title_en: A-share close: ChiNext Index opens higher and rallies over 3%, 'Yi Zhong Tian' all surge over 13%
headlines.summary_en: The market opened higher and rose throughout the day, with the ChiNext Index gaining more than 3% in the afternoon. Computing power hardware stocks rebounded sharply, with Yuanjie Technology, Dongshan Precision, Accelink Technologies, Cambridge Technology and many others hitting the daily limit up, while Zhongji Innolight, Eoptolink and TFC Optical Communication each rose more than 13%. The AI comic drama concept remained active, with Shanghai Film hitting the daily limit up to a new high, and Wintime Holdings and Kaiser Culture also sealing the limit up. Robotics concept stocks continued their strength, with Fulai New Materials posting a second consecutive limit-up to a new high, and more than ten stocks including Xiangyang Bearing, Fenglong Shares and Ruide Zhiqu hitting the limit up. On the downside, the photovoltaic sector rose then fell back, with Maxwell Technologies down nearly 10%. More stocks rose than fell, with over 3,500 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets in the green, and turnover today at nearly 1.69 trillion yuan. As of the close, the Shanghai Composite Index rose 0.46%, the Shenzhen Component Index rose 1.32%, and the ChiNext Index rose 3.11%.

headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, November 11 — Shanghai Shuzhi Hengchu Energy Technology Co., Ltd. was recently established, with Li Xiaoxun as legal representative. Its business scope includes industrial internet data services, IoT technology R&D, photovoltaic power generation equipment leasing, artificial intelligence basic software development, artificial intelligence application software development, and more.
